facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Aimed Shot is baseline for every Hunter at level 20 and shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. Arcane Shot now shares a cooldown with Beast Mastery's Summon Hawk instead.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: You can lay traps in combat and fire traps scale with Attack Power. All traps now share one 30-second cooldown, replacing the separate fire and frost cooldowns.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Since 16 Oct, Auto Shot needs about half a second of standing still before it fires. Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot no longer stop Auto Shot, and a new setting switches between Auto Attack and Auto Shot for you.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Scorpid Sting now lowers the target's hit chance by 2%, Disengage drops twice as much threat, and Aspect of the Beast also grants melee Attack Power.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Pets scale with your gear but can no longer take player buffs that raise their stats. Each family has one unique ability, Foxes are a new family, and since 16 Oct pets use the higher of your melee or ranged crit.

facts.label: Talent data
facts.value: Beast Mastery: Thick Hide is folded into Endurance Training and Improved Eyes of the Beast is now baseline. Focused Fire and Summon Hawk are new, Pathfinding moved, and Improved Revive Pet, Frenzy and Bestial Wrath are unchanged.
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Talent data
facts.value: Marksmanship: Aimed Shot and Improved Hunter's Mark are now baseline, and Improved Scorpid Sting is gone. Careful Aim, Rapid Killing, Lone Wolf, Rapid Recuperation and Sniper Shot are new, Hawk Eye and Scatter Shot moved, and Improved Concussive Shot and Ranged Weapon Specialization are unchanged.
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Talent data
facts.value: Survival: Monster Slaying, Humanoid Slaying, Trap Mastery, Improved Feign Death, Killer Instinct and Wyvern Sting are gone. Improved Tracking, Survival Tactics, Predator's Edge, Resourcefulness, Expose Prey, Survivalist's Discipline, Strider Kick and Lacerating Strikes are new.
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Taming the Beast (Level 10)
facts.value: Your trainer starts a race-specific chain of three Taming the Beast quests, then Training the Beast, which unlocks Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet. Skyborne have their own versions on Zephras Isle; Warcraft Tavern does not yet list the chain for Human Hunters.

facts.label: Pet scaling
facts.value: Pets inherit 10% of your Attack Power and 100% of your crit, per Warcraft Tavern; since 16 Oct they use the higher of your melee or ranged crit and benefit from Expertise.

facts.label: Summon Hawk
facts.value: Deals 32 plus 5% of your Ranged Attack Power, then keeps attacking for 18 seconds. Only 2 hawks can be out, and it shares Arcane Shot's cooldown.
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Unleashed Fury and Ferocity
facts.value: Weaker than in Classic but now also buff hawks.

facts.label: Focused Fire
facts.value: You and your pet deal more damage while the pet is active (1% at rank 1, 2 ranks).
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Hit cap at level 60
facts.note: No Blizzard figure. Warcraft Tavern's Hunter guides repeat the Classic 1.12 values, and other guides disagree.

facts.label: Racials
facts.value: Dwarf Artisan's Precision +1% hit, Human Ruthless +1% crit and Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste (26 Oct).

facts.label: Raid outlook
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern calls Beast Mastery competitive, but says Marksmanship and Survival can out-damage it in some fights and that pet deaths hurt it.

facts.label: Trueshot Aura
facts.value: Raid-wide since 16 Oct and now in Marksmanship row 4.

facts.label: Tranquilizing Shot
facts.value: Hunters bring Tranquilizing Shot to remove Enrage and Frenzy effects.

facts.label: Wolf Furious Howl
facts.value: Raises party melee Attack Power; its bonus was cut by 40% on 24 Sep.

facts.label: Onyxia's Lair entry
facts.value: Every raider needs their own Drakefire Amulet in their bags, and Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance first.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open on 9 December 2026, all planned to reset weekly.

facts.label: Ammo
facts.value: Blizzard has not announced any ammo change. Warcraft Tavern says to keep a quiver or ammo pouch stocked, because running out means no ranged attacks.

facts.label: Pet food
facts.value: Happiness still scales pet damage (125%, 100% or 75%), so keep Feed Pet supplies on hand.

facts.label: Elixir of Cunning
facts.value: New in Forever: +25 Agility and Intellect for 30 minutes (Alchemy 275). Careful Aim turns Intellect into Attack Power.

facts.label: Food in Forever
facts.value: Grilled Squid now gives +1% crit instead of Agility, and Tender Wolf Steak gives +15 Agility.

facts.label: Healing potions
facts.value: Made with First Aid instead of Alchemy in Forever.

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Icy Veins' raid overview says world buffs are removed inside raids, and Wowhead's Forever data marks Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer 'No effect while in a raid instance'.

facts.label: Lone Wolf
facts.value: +20% damage with all attacks while no pet is active; skipping it carries no penalty since 24 Sep.

facts.label: Careful Aim
facts.value: Converts 20% to 100% of your Intellect into Attack Power.

facts.label: Sniper Shot
facts.value: A 4-second cast on a 15-second cooldown with a 45-yard range. Your next three shots gain 10 yards of range. November doubled the bonus damage.
facts.note: The same notes list a 0.15 Attack Power coefficient for Arcane Shot and 5% of Attack Power per tick for Serpent Sting.

facts.label: Rapid Killing
facts.value: Cuts Rapid Fire's cooldown by 1 minute per rank (2 minutes at 2/2), and a kill or a Serpent Sting death raises your next Shot's damage by 10% per rank.
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Hit cap at level 60
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern's Hunter guides give the Classic 1.12 figures; no Forever value has been published.

facts.label: Raid outlook
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern rates Marksmanship highly for endgame and says Lone Wolf is valuable in PvE.

facts.label: Trueshot Aura
facts.value: Raid-wide since 16 Oct.

facts.label: Range
facts.value: Hunters have the longest range of any class.

facts.label: Onyxia's Lair entry
facts.value: Every raider needs their own Drakefire Amulet in their bags.

facts.label: Fire resistance target for Onyxia
facts.note: Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance but gives no number.

facts.label: Savage Strikes
facts.value: +2% crit chance for all melee abilities at rank 1 (2 ranks).
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Predator's Edge
facts.value: +6% melee ability crit damage and +10% off-hand weapon damage at rank 1 (5 ranks).
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Lacerating Strikes
facts.value: Mongoose Bite also makes the target bleed for 40% of the bite's damage over 21 seconds.
facts.recheck: Checked against the 16 October talent data; not yet re-checked against the 10 November data.

facts.label: Surefooted
facts.value: Its hit bonus now applies to all attacks.

facts.label: Hit cap at level 60
facts.note: No Blizzard figure. Warcraft Tavern's Hunter guides repeat the Classic 1.12 values.

facts.label: Raid outlook
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern calls Survival competitive in all PvE content.

facts.label: Rapid Fire (talentsforever data)
facts.value: Also grants +40% melee attack speed in Forever.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open on 9 December 2026.
